recommendation.reason: 需要离开主机处理 DSH 会话的用户可以先在隔离局域网核对配对流程。相比直接开放整个 WebUI，它提供专用的设备认证和移动端协议。若宿主权限、连接范围或撤销无法验收，应关闭网关并恢复原入口。

# dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway > 为 DSH 提供设备配对、移动会话同步和可选实验传输。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway) - **版本号**：0.11.3（[固定提交 d0697ee7ac0238649a185f445dea7e8fce80ebcc](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway/tree/d0697ee7ac0238649a185f445dea7e8fce80ebcc)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-05（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定网关和作者协议说明，未运行宿主、网络或移动设备。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要从受控网络上的移动设备查看或操作 DSH 会话的开发者。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 将设备配对和宿主会话调用纳入移动端协议。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 设备认证与宿主授权不同，真实网络边界未验。 - **建议**：[Q04](#research-q04) 用重连和撤销故障对照传输可靠性。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 先只在受控 LAN 检查。[Q02](#research-q02) 设备和 owner Peer 权限需分别验收。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 将设备配对和宿主会话调用纳入移动端协议。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 设备认证与宿主授权不同，真实网络边界未验。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q04](#research-q04) 用重连和撤销故障对照传输可靠性。 核对 LAN 拒绝、配对、撤销、重连与会话权限。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要从受控网络上的移动设备查看或操作 DSH 会话的开发者。 使用原 WebUI 或返回主机操作。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：移动配对如何进入宿主，网络与身份边界在哪里？ ### Q01 · 手机连接怎样到宿主？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 希望离开主机后查看或操作同一 DSH 会话的人，原本需要打开原 WebUI 或回到主机。网关接收移动端协议，先核对配对码或设备令牌，再启用业务通道。配对需要稳定设备 ID，已有设备可在有效配对下换令牌。向 DSH 的调用使用宿主创建的 owner Peer，手机不自选宿主身份。增量是统一移动协议与宿主远端调用，而非为每设备建立独立的 DSH 用户。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/index.mjs:2298-2306](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway/blob/d0697ee7ac0238649a185f445dea7e8fce80ebcc/lib/index.mjs#L2298-L2306) 宿主 Peer 及前置检查 ```text if (typeof ctx.connection?.createPeer !== 'function') { throw new Error('mobile-gateway requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later with Connection.createPeer') } // 已配对设备沿用本机用户权限；身份只由 Host 创建，不能由移动端参数指定。 // 问答与审批仍由本插件的 Host 监听器处理，无需另开 Remote 交互流。 const peer = ctx.connection.createPeer({ principal: { kind: 'owner' }, interactions: 'none' }) const api = createDshHostAdapter(ctx.typertGateway, peer, ctx.connection) const host = api const agentDefaultModel = ctx.agentDefaultModel ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/index.mjs:3291-3331](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway/blob/d0697ee7ac0238649a185f445dea7e8fce80ebcc/lib/index.mjs#L3291-L3331) 移动连接认证及业务通道

查看原文（16行） ````text ## Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer Mobile clients use this project's `dsh-mobile-v1`, not DSH's internal Remote protocol. A separate Host Adapter connects to the DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 Remote Gateway. Namespaces such as Session, Workspace, Settings, Commands, Goals, Schedule, Permission Presets, and Plugin Manager, together with their strict parameters, are confined to that adapter. See the [RC2 plugin management integration plan](docs/dsh-0.2.0-rc.2-plugin-management-mobile-integration.md) for request frames and mobile UI design. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 requires `peer` on every Remote call. The gateway creates a local-user Peer with `ctx.connection.createPeer()` and disposes of it with the plugin. The Host Adapter injects it into regular requests, initial reads, and live subscriptions; mobile clients cannot choose the caller identity. Questions and approvals still use the gateway's Host listeners. Older gateways that omit it fail with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'signal')`. After upgrading DSH, reinstall this source version and restart `dsh web`; the phone protocol needs no change. Verify this contract against a locally installed official DSH (real Gateway/Connection, test business services, no user sessions read or written): ```bash DSH_INSTALL_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/@deepseek-ai/dsh node test/host-official.test.mjs ``` Pairing authentication and `dsh-mobile-v1` / `hello.protocol = 3` are unchanged. Live tokens no longer consume persistent event `seq` values: explicitly subscribe with `assistantStream: true` to receive an atomic `session-snapshot` and separate deltas. Regular `event` frames contain only persistent events. Clients without the new subscription receive persistent messages only. History responses include `historyFormatVersion` and `cursor`. Clear history caches and install a fresh baseline when the format changes. Pagination with `beforeSeq` or a fork with `atSeq` must also send `historyFormatVersion: 4`. See the [rc.2 mobile integration guide](docs/dsh-rc2-mobile-integration.md) for current integration and acceptance checks, and the [Remote Gateway refactoring plan](docs/remote-gateway-refactor-plan.md) for earlier migration records. ````

The RTC library is a required runtime dependency installed automatically with the plugin; no separate dependency installation is needed. Prerequisites: `dsh` CLI and `pnpm` installed, with `dsh web` working. Run `pnpm --version` to ensure the current user can find `pnpm`. For LAN use, install the plugin: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway@latest ``` For public-IP access on a Linux server, use the unified initializer. It installs/updates the plugin and requests sudo once to install the system Helper: ```bash npx --yes dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway@latest init ``` `init` installs the exact version of the executing npm package into the DSH profile and skips pnpm's new-release waiting period for that version only, keeping plugin and Helper versions aligned. After installation, stop and restart WebUI: ```bash dsh web ``` Open WebUI and confirm Mobile Devices appears at the bottom of the left sidebar. ## LAN Pairing For the DSH computer and mobile device on the same mutually reachable LAN. 1. Open Mobile Devices in WebUI. 2. Set Gateway Mode to Persistent, or Temporary for short pairing sessions. 3. Leave Device Authentication enabled. 4. First use defaults to Direct LAN. Verify `ws://<电脑局域网 IP>:3081/ws/mobile`. For guidance, open Connection & Pairing → Help me choose a connection, then select the phone’s network, host type and Tailscale setup. Review the recommendation and prerequisites; settings are saved only when you choose Use this recommendation. The guide stays collapsed until clicked. Manual connection settings and the pairing address remain visible, including the option to select P2P. Cloudflare Tunnel can remain enabled. 5. Enter a device name and select Generate Pairing QR Code. 6. Open device authentication in the mobile client and scan the QR code. 7. Pairing is complete when the trusted device shows Online in WebUI.
